ctl.title: Remote Control
ctl.accEnabled: Accessibility service enabled — remote control ready
ctl.accSteps:
Setup steps:
1. Tap the button below to open Accessibility settings directly.
2. Find NexusLink in the list of downloaded services.
3. Open it and turn on "Use service".
4. Confirm the warning dialog — the service does nothing outside a control session you explicitly accept.
ctl.confirmTitle: Ask for confirmation at session start
ctl.confirmSubtitle: When enabled, an Allow/Deny notification appears before the computer touches your screen. When disabled, sessions start automatically from trusted devices only.
ctl.trustedSubtitle: Devices not paired and trusted in the server registry cannot request control at all — requests are rejected before reaching your phone.
ctl.howBody: When a session starts from the computer, its touches are injected on your phone through the accessibility service with pixel precision: tap, long-press, drag, scroll, text into the focused field, and system buttons (back/home/recents). You can cut instantly from the home screen or here at any time, and control always ends when the server connection is lost.

header.title: Media & Camera — your phone is the server's eye and ear

cam.title: Quick cam — broadcast on server request
cam.idle: Mini preview appears here when streaming starts
cam.note: Audio+video stream over WebRTC to the media bridge — the web watches it as a webcam and in video calls. A system notification with a stop button appears while streaming.

shot.title: Remote shutter — photo as a file
shot.sent: Photo sent as a file: {name} — visible in your device files on the web
shot.note: On a computer command (cam:shutter) the same path runs automatically: countdown + torch, then upload through the same transfer protocol.

watch.title: Surveillance mode — continuous stream + motion
watch.note: Continuous camera stream with frame-difference motion detection (simple pixel math — no AI). On motion a sec:motion alert is pushed to the web security panel.

baby.title: Baby monitor — audio only
baby.note: Continuous microphone stream with the screen off (WakeLock prevents Doze). Loud audio pushes a baby:alert to the web.

mic.title: Phone as server microphone
mic.note: On-demand audio stream — your computer speakers hear this phone via the mic channel.

sensors.title: Sensors for the web
sensors.note: Gyroscope/accelerometer streamed over WebSocket ({count} msgs) — the web UI can later use it as a gamepad.

find.title: Find my phone
find.note: From the web guard panel («Find my phone» tab): the ring button plays max volume ignoring silent mode with vibration and screen wake — executed in the background service even with the app closed; «Light» wakes the screen and blinks the torch for 5 seconds.

err.perms: Grant camera and microphone permissions in Settings to enable streaming

rctl.offline: Control bridge offline — connect to the server first

pad.title: Touchpad — move the computer cursor
pad.hint: Drag to move · double-tap · long-press to drag · two fingers to scroll/pinch

kbd.title: Wireless keyboard (Arabic/English)
kbd.hint: Type here — keystrokes go straight to the computer

air.title: Air Mouse — phone gyroscope

clip.watchSub: Polls every 1.5s while this screen is open (Android 10+ limit)
clip.autoSub: Or use the manual send button below
